scope: One schema assertion only; no data, grouping, feature, model, parameter, threshold, metric, seed, or comparison changes.
before: assert all(r["source_id"] == r["response_id"] for r in data["halubench_full"])
after: assert all(r["source_id"] == "halubench:" + r["response_id"] for r in data["halubench_full"])
